2: (() => {
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');

15:     speed: 0.03, // angular speed per frame

17:     minOrbit: planet.r + 20,
18:     maxOrbit: Math.min(W, H) / 2 - 20,
19:   };
20: 
21:   const asteroids = [];
22:   const powerUps = [];
23:   let gameOver = false;
24:   let score = 0;
25: 
26:   // Utility
27:   const rand = (a, b) => Math.random() * (b - a) + a;
28: 
29:   function spawnAsteroid() {
30:     const side = Math.floor(rand(0, 4)); // 0:top 1:right 2:bottom 3:left
31:     let x, y, vx, vy;
32:     const speed = rand(1, 3);
33:     if (side === 0) { x = rand(0, W); y = -20; vx = rand(-1, 1); vy = speed; }
34:     else if (side === 1) { x = W + 20; y = rand(0, H); vx = -speed; vy = rand(-1, 1); }
35:     else if (side === 2) { x = rand(0, W); y = H + 20; vx = rand(-1, 1); vy = -speed; }
36:     else { x = -20; y = rand(0, H); vx = speed; vy = rand(-1, 1); }
37:     const r = rand(5, 12);
38:     asteroids.push({ x, y, vx, vy, r });
39:   }

44:     const x = planet.x + Math.cos(angle) * radius;
45:     const y = planet.y + Math.sin(angle) * radius;
46:     powerUps.push({ x, y, r: 6, collected: false });
47:   }
48: 
49:   // Input handling
50:   const keys = {};
51:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => keys[e.key] = true);
52:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => keys[e.key] = false);
53: 
54:   function update() {
55:     if (gameOver) return;
56:     // player controls
57:     if (keys['ArrowLeft']) player.angle -= player.speed;
58:     if (keys['ArrowRight']) player.angle += player.speed;
59:     if (keys['ArrowUp']) {
60:       player.radius = Math.min(player.radius + player.thrust, player.maxOrbit);
61:     }
62:     // simple gravity pull towards planet if not thrusting
63:     player.radius = Math.max(player.radius - 0.1, player.minOrbit);
64: 
65:     // move asteroids
66:     asteroids.forEach(a => { a.x += a.vx; a.y += a.vy; });
67:     // remove off‑screen asteroids
68:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
69:       const a = asteroids[i];

77:     // asteroid collisions
